note: Every block in a commune file names its source with `source: <key>`; the key's entry here gives the dataset name, url, licence and year/period. See docs/data-communes.md.

cog.name: INSEE — Code officiel géographique (COG) 2026 : communes, arrondissements municipaux, cantons

geoapi.name: API Découpage administratif (geo.api.gouv.fr) — codes postaux (La Poste) et centre des communes (IGN Admin Express)

population.name: INSEE — Populations de référence (population municipale), via l'API Melodi
population.note: Population municipale, as used in public/data/districts. Missing communes fall back to geo.api.gouv.fr (latest legal population).

districtsMap.name: Commune → legislative district shares, built in public/data/districts from the Ministère de l'Intérieur 2024 polling-station results

crime.name: SSMSI (Ministère de l'Intérieur) — Base statistique communale de la délinquance enregistrée par la police et la gendarmerie nationales
crime.method: Commune values as published by SSMSI (count, rate per 1,000 inhabitants; burglary per 1,000 dwellings). Paris, Lyon and Marseille: whole city.

census.name: INSEE — Recensement de la population, Population active et chômage (DS_RP_EMPLOI_LR_PRINC), via l'API Melodi
census.definition: Census unemployment rate of people aged 15–64 (self-declared, census definition — differs from the ILO rate). Census 2023 = annual surveys 2021–2025.

ilo.name: INSEE — Taux de chômage localisés par département (BDM, série TAUX-CHOMAGE, CVS)
ilo.definition: INSEE localised unemployment rate (ILO definition, quarterly average, seasonally adjusted).

filosofi.name: INSEE — Filosofi : niveau de vie médian et taux de pauvreté (DS_FILOSOFI_CC), via l'API Melodi
filosofi.definition: Median standard of living (disposable income per consumption unit, € per year) and poverty rate (% of people below 60 % of the metropolitan median).

ofgl.name: OFGL — Comptes consolidés des communes (budget principal + budgets annexes), source DGFiP

schools.name: Éducation nationale — Annuaire de l'éducation, IPS, IVAC (DNB), IVAL (bac)

ipsCollege.name: Éducation nationale — Indices de position sociale des collèges (à partir de 2023)

ipsLycee.name: Éducation nationale — Indices de position sociale des lycées (à partir de 2023)

dnb.name: Éducation nationale — Indicateurs de valeur ajoutée des collèges (IVAC, DNB)

bacGT.name: Éducation nationale — Indicateurs de valeur ajoutée des lycées d'enseignement général et technologique (IVAL)

bacPro.name: Éducation nationale — Indicateurs de valeur ajoutée des lycées d'enseignement professionnel (IVAL)

schools.note: Indicators as published by the ministry (IPS = social position index of pupils' families; VA = value added: observed minus expected result given the pupils' profile). The ministry publishes no ranking and none is computed here.

rne.name: Ministère de l'Intérieur — Répertoire national des élus (RNE)
rne.note: Only public-role fields are kept (name, function, start of mandate/function). The RNE does not publish political lists or nuances.

merimee.name: Ministère de la Culture — Immeubles protégés au titre des Monuments historiques (base Mérimée)

museofile.name: Ministère de la Culture — Répertoire des Musées de France (base Muséofile)
museofile.method: The file has no INSEE code: each museum is placed by its postcode and town name; when a postcode covers several communes, or is unknown, by the commune whose centre is nearest to the museum coordinates (within the department, ~10 km).

libraries.name: Ministère de la Culture (Service du livre et de la lecture) — Les bibliothèques des collectivités territoriales : adresses et données d'activité
libraries.method: Libraries whose address type is 'Bâtiment ouvert' (open to the public); county lending services (bibliothèques départementales) excluded.

dataes.name: Ministère chargé des Sports — Data ES, recensement des équipements sportifs et lieux de pratique
dataes.method: Count of sports equipments (a facility, e.g. a sports complex, can hold several) by family, excluding installations marked out of service.

apl.name: DREES — Indicateur d'accessibilité potentielle localisée (APL) aux médecins généralistes
apl.unit: consultations/visits accessible per standardised inhabitant per year
apl.method: Commune value as published. For communes merged after the source's geography, the mean of the former communes weighted by standardised population (DREES's recommended aggregation) — flagged method: 'merged'.

national.note: Computed here from the same file: mean weighted by standardised population; share of the population living in communes with APL < 2.5.

arcep.name: ARCEP — Le marché du haut et très haut débit fixe (déploiements) : observatoire, onglets Communes et Arrondissements
arcep.method: share = 100 × premises connectable to FttH (locaux raccordables, latest quarter) / ARCEP's best estimate of the number of premises (capped at 100).

dvf.name: DGFiP — Demandes de valeurs foncières géolocalisées (DVF), 2025
dvf.method: Computed here with the Etalab 'Statistiques DVF' rules: sales, off-plan sales (VEFA) and auctions of a single house or apartment (outbuildings ignored); price per m² = sale value / built surface (surface réelle bâtie); prices above 100,000 €/m² dropped; median per commune (arrondissement in Paris, Lyon, Marseille). Medians on few sales are volatile: check `sales`.
dvf.coverage: DVF does not cover Alsace-Moselle (Bas-Rhin, Haut-Rhin, Moselle: Livre foncier) or Mayotte.

dvfStats.name: data.gouv.fr (Etalab) — Statistiques DVF, statistiques totales (10 derniers semestres)
dvfStats.note: Official pre-aggregated medians over the whole available period (5 years); there is no official per-year median file (only monthly medians).

wikidata.name: Wikidata — items with an INSEE municipality code (P374): image (P18) and French Wikipedia sitelink

commons.name: Wikimedia Commons — file pages (author, licence) via the MediaWiki API

wikipedia.name: Wikipédia en français — introduction of the commune's article (first sentences), via the MediaWiki API
wikipedia.attribution: Text from the French Wikipedia article (see url), by its contributors (history: url + '?action=history'), licensed CC BY-SA 4.0; shortened.

theftFromPersons.fr: Vols sans violence contre des personnes

fraud.fr: Escroqueries et fraudes aux moyens de paiement

stateTransfers.en: State transfers received (DGF and other State grants) — a receipt, not State spending

gpAccess.fr: Accessibilité potentielle localisée (APL) aux médecins généralistes
gpAccess.en: Local potential accessibility to general practitioners
gpAccess.unit: consultations/visits per standardised inhabitant per year
gpAccess.under65: Same, counting only GPs aged 65 or under

ftth.en: Premises where fibre to the home can be connected

property.medianPerM2: Median price per m² (€), single-property sales
